name: Podcasting

naics.title: Media Streaming Distribution Services, Social Networks, and Other Media Networks and Content Providers

one_line: Earns a listener's trust one episode at a time, then sells that attention to advertisers.
sells: Ad slots read by hosts, plus subscriptions and exclusive deals
customers: Advertisers and their agencies; listeners pay with attention
suppliers: Hosts and producers, audio and video platforms, ad-tech

revenue.note: Ad revenue only; excludes subscriptions, live shows and markets outside the US.

structure.why: Thousands of shows, but a handful of networks sell most of the ads. Only reach rankings are public, not revenue shares.
structure.hhi_note: Not computable: no public revenue shares.

econ: Two-sided market: free content draws listeners, listeners draw advertisers. The host's personal trust is the scarce input.

companies.name: Spotify
companies.note: #1 US podcast network by weekly reach, Q2 2026 (Edison/SSRS).

companies.name: YouTube
companies.note: Passed 1 billion monthly podcast viewers in 2025 (TheWrap). A platform, not a network, so Edison's network ranking doesn't list it.
